verdict.rationale: Unity's docs directly document extending the editor via custom inspectors, Editor Windows, and Property Drawers, plus scripting against public Unity APIs and the Asset Database for programmatic asset/scene manipulation, backed by a Package Manager ecosystem for distributing plugins. This is core, well-documented first-party functionality. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration specifically praising editor-scripting workflows (community evidence here focuses on pricing/licensing, not editor extensibility).
